full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman, J: This criminal petition for leave to appeal by the accused-petitioner is against the judgment and order dated 12.3.98 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 862 of 1996 discharging the Rule and refusing to quash G.R. Case No. 2652 of 1995 arising out of Ramna Police Station case No. 85(10)/95 pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. 

 2. Respondent No. 2 filed a petition of complaint alleging that the accused-petitioner took Tk. 13,10,000/- from him for sending men abroad for employment. The accused petitioner did not fulfil the promise. The accused-petitioner returned only Tk. 2,80,000/- to respondent No. 2 and executed a bond to pay an amount of Tk. 10,00,000/- but did not pay the said amount. On these allegations the case was started against the accused-petitioner. 

 3. Mr. Khondaker Mahbub Hossain, learned Advocate appearing for the accused-petitioner submits that from the petition of complaint no prima facie criminal case is made out against the petitioner, only a civil case of non-performance of conditions of a bond has been alleged and as such the learned Judges of the High Court Division ought to have quashed the proceeding. 

 4. The learned Judges of the High Court Division found from the petition of complaint that the accused-petitioner prima facie dishonestly induced the complainant to part with the informant's money and thereafter misappropriated the sum. The learned Judges found prima facie allegation of initial deception and also that the accused refused to pay the balance amount. The learned Judges of the High Court Division having found a prima facie case for trial it is not for this Division to interfere with the same. Apart from the face that there is no merit in the case, the petition is also barred by 40 days.
